text_block_list.text:
After the weekend, Air Groove
came to the Trainer's Office, so...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What do you intend to gain by prying into my days off...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Besides, don't you have a mountain of other things you should be doing instead...? Good grief."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My days off are the same as always.
Nothing particularly out of the ordinary.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I thoroughly enjoyed my day off.
That is all. Are you satisfied now?
